notes.session_06_w5: 2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 5. CombinedNotionAdapter delegates each operation to the API or browser adapter per PLATFORM_COMPATIBILITY.md. reports_unsupported is checked before the call and may route to the other adapter, including for a non-idempotent write, because nothing has been invoked yet. OperationUnsupportedError is raised before any side effect and selects the other adapter only for a read or other idempotent operation. After a non-idempotent write has been invoked, no exception selects the other adapter, including NotImplementedError, its subclasses, and OperationUnsupportedError. A TypeError and an auth-style error propagate and the other adapter is not called. A read or other idempotent operation that raises RuntimeError, ConnectionError, ValueError, KeyError, AttributeError, LookupError, or NotImplementedError propagates that same error, and the other adapter is not called. TypeError and PermissionError on a non-idempotent write, including a browser-preferred write, propagate the same way. When the fallback also fails, the second error is chained from the first. get_public_url is COMBINED: the API delegate returns the public URL and the browser delegate verifies stranger access; None from the API skips the browser, and a failed stranger check returns None. set_view_title_visibility passes database_id, view_id, and visible through unchanged and returns the delegate NotionView. NotionOperationReceipt and NotionOperationReceiptLog are the typed stub from prompt section 4 (job id, operation, workspace, page/database target, pre-state, post-state, provider response, evidence, timestamp, idempotency key, status). Timestamps must be timezone-aware. Status is Success, Unknown, or Failure. A torn trailing line that is not newline-terminated and is not JSON is skipped on load and truncated before the next append. An incomplete UTF-8 tail is skipped the same way. A complete JSON line with no trailing newline is kept, and a newline is added before the next append. Writers of one resolved path in this process share one lock object and re-read before append. A different path gets a different lock. The lock registry is weak, and each log keeps its lock alive. A str path and a missing parent directory are rejected. Caller mappings are copied before store. Nested mappings, lists, and tuples are frozen at every depth into new containers, so a frozen mapping can be snapshotted again without deepcopy. dataclasses.replace keeps nested pre_state, post_state, and provider_response frozen and equal. Mutating the caller's nested dict and list leaves the receipt unchanged. A caller MappingProxyType, including one nested inside another mapping, is copied into fresh containers. Mutating that inner list leaves the receipt unchanged. A reference cycle raises ValueError. More than 32 levels below the field mapping is rejected (33 nested containers are accepted, counting the field mapping as level 0; 34 are rejected). record() writes pure ASCII, including when a field contains non-ASCII text. A threading.Lock inside state raises ValueError. Mapping keys must be strings at every level. reports_unsupported must return bool. A public URL that is not a string is rejected before the browser runs. NaN and Inf are rejected. Persistence is an injected path only. test_translating_session_keeps_original_playwright_error_as_cause is parametrized over the eight TranslatingBrowserSession methods.
